about: The proposal's criterion 3 (section 10): questions about FAST-AF's components, each with the JSON value that answers it, and tags that do not exist. tests/facts.rs briefs every tag at once; each fact must be in the brief, or in the components-open call its omitted names. section is a brief section, or floor (the entry's own fields) or ruleText (a shared rule's text); match picks one item of a list section; field is the item's field, compared with basis left out; contains is a value the section's list holds. The answers were read from violet-elements' pack when this was written and are not regenerated: a change to one is a change to what the brief answers.

facts.question: Which values does violet-button's type attribute take?
What is violet-button's type by default?
What type does violet-button's appearance attribute have?
Is violet-button's disabled a boolean?
What goes in violet-button's before slot?
facts.answer: Leading inline content such as an icon.

facts.question: Which shared rule governs violet-button's type attribute?
Where is violet-button imported from?
Which role does violet-combobox expose when open?
Is violet-combobox form-associated?
What does violet-combobox's change event mean?
facts.answer: Emitted when an option is chosen or the text is committed.

facts.question: How does violet-combobox filter its options?
facts.answer: Typing filters by label, ignoring case and punctuation; arrow keys skip non-matching options, and "No matching options" shows when none match. Unchosen text is discarded on Tab, Escape or an outside press.

facts.question: Where does violet-select's open listbox get its name?
facts.answer: from the label and the shown value

facts.question: Which elements does violet-select's default slot accept?
How is violet-select named for assistive technology?
facts.answer: The trigger is named by the label plus the shown value. Without a label its name is only the value or placeholder text.

facts.question: Which role does violet-dialog have as an alert?
What is violet-dialog's type by default?
When does violet-dialog fire request-close?
facts.answer: Emitted before close. Call preventDefault() to cancel.

facts.question: What is violet-dialog's title slot for?
facts.answer: Dialog title text, auto-wired to aria-labelledby.

facts.question: Which element goes in violet-tabs' tab slot?
Which orientation do violet-tabs take by default?
Does the pack hold an example of violet-tabs?
Which role does violet-tab have?
How long does violet-tooltip wait before it shows, by default?
Where does violet-tooltip show by default?
Which role does an open violet-tooltip have?
Which sizes does violet-spinner come in?
When is violet-spinner decorative?
facts.answer: Set decorative when visible text nearby, such as "Saving...", already says it is loading; it is then hidden from assistive technology.

facts.question: Where does violet-option get its accessible name?
What does violet-option's request-select event mean?
facts.answer: Emitted when the option is chosen, for the list that owns it.

facts.question: Which element is violet-menu's trigger?
Which role does an open violet-menu have?
What is violet-progress's max by default?
How is violet-progress made indeterminate?
facts.answer: Set value="" for indeterminate, which also hides the percentage. With no value attribute it shows 0, and a value that is not a number is treated as 0.

facts.question: What value does violet-checkbox submit by default?
What type is violet-checkbox's indeterminate?
What is the default of violet-checkbox's --_border-strong?
Which element goes in violet-text-field's before slot?
What does violet-text-field's overview example look like?
facts.answer: <violet-text-field label="Plant name" name="plantName" placeholder="Search cultivated rows" required supporting-text="Use this for quick filtering or manual entry." type="search"><violet-icon decorative icon="system/search" label slot="before"></violet-icon></violet-text-field>

facts.question: What does the shared rule taxonomy.type say?
facts.answer: Passes through the native HTML control type when the component wraps a native form control with standard type semantics. Not for: visual variants; business modes; custom component family names.

facts.question: What does violet-menu-item's invoke event mean?
facts.answer: Emitted when the item is activated (click, Enter, or Space). Not fired when disabled.

facts.question: Is violet-radio-group form-associated?
What is violet-badge for?
facts.answer: Compact, non-interactive inline label for a status, category or count.
